title: A distinct mechanism of epigenetic reprogramming silences PAX2 and initiates endometrial carcinogenesis.
authors: Sahoo, Subhransu S; Ramanand, Susmita G; Cuevas, Ileana C; Gao, Yunpeng; Lee, Sora; Abbas, Ahmed; Zhang, Xunzhi; Kumar, Ashwani; Koduru, Prasad; Roy, Sambit; Broaddus, Russell R; Bae-Jump, Victoria L; Gladden, Andrew B; Lea, Jayanthi; Lucas, Elena; Xing, Chao; Kobayashi, Akio; Mani, Ram S; Castrillon, Diego H
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过整合转录组、表观基因组和机器学习分析，揭示PAX2肿瘤抑制基因通过组蛋白修饰重编程而非DNA突变被沉默的机制，但核心是表观遗传调控而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且未涉及TF-DNA结合或分子模拟方法。
abstract: Functional inactivation of tumor suppressor genes drives cancer initiation, progression, and treatment responses. Most tumor suppressor genes are inactivated through 1 of 2 well-characterized mechanisms: DNA-level mutations, such as point mutations or deletions, and promoter DNA hypermethylation. Here, we report a distinct third mechanism of tumor suppressor inactivation based on alterations to the histone rather than DNA code. We demonstrated that PAX2 is an endometrial tumor suppressor recurrently inactivated by a distinct epigenetic reprogramming event in more than 80% of human endometrial cancers. Integrative transcriptomic, epigenomic, 3D genomic, and machine learning analyses showed that PAX2 transcriptional downregulation is associated with replacement of open/active chromatin features (H3K27ac/H3K4me3) with inaccessible/repressive chromatin features (H3K27me3) in a framework dictated by 3D genome organization. The spread of the repressive H3K27me3 signal resembled a pearl necklace, with its length modulated by cohesin loops, thereby preventing transcriptional dysregulation of neighboring genes. This mechanism, involving the loss of a promoter-proximal superenhancer, was shown to underlie transcriptional silencing of PAX2 in human endometrial cancers. Mouse and human preclinical models established PAX2 as a potent endometrial tumor suppressor. Functionally, PAX2 loss promoted endometrial carcinogenesis by rewiring the transcriptional landscape via global enhancer reprogramming. The discovery that most endometrial cancers originate from a recurring epigenetic alteration carries profound implications for their diagnosis and treatment.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制基因的功能性失活驱动癌症的发生、进展及治疗反应。大多数肿瘤抑制基因通过两种特征明确的机制之一失活：DNA水平突变，如点突变或缺失，以及启动子DNA高甲基化。在此，我们报告了一种基于组蛋白而非DNA编码改变的肿瘤抑制失活的第三种独特机制。我们证明PAX2是一种子宫内膜肿瘤抑制基因，在超过80%的人类子宫内膜癌中通过一种独特的表观遗传重编程事件反复失活。整合转录组学、表观基因组学、三维基因组学和机器学习分析表明，PAX2转录下调与开放/活性染色质特征（H3K27ac/H3K4me3）被不可及/抑制性染色质特征（H3K27me3）替代相关，这一过程受三维基因组组织框架的调控。抑制性H3K27me3信号的扩散类似于珍珠项链，其长度由cohesin环调节，从而防止邻近基因的转录失调。这一机制涉及启动子近端超级增强子的丢失，被证明是人类子宫内膜癌中PAX2转录沉默的基础。小鼠和人类临床前模型确立了PAX2作为强效子宫内膜肿瘤抑制因子的作用。在功能上，PAX2缺失通过全局增强子重编程重塑转录景观，促进子宫内膜癌发生。大多数子宫内膜癌源于反复出现的表观遗传改变的发现，对其诊断和治疗具有深远意义。
